notes.title: Campus Life - Hotfix #5 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ec0c325031ead551ead1895f9f47a2814bdab1ee.png"]

Hi Students!

We've just released another hotfix addressing several issues to improve your gameplay experience even further. We appreciate everyone that reports any problems, thanks to you we can seriously make the game even better for everyone.

Here's a list of fixes and improvements:

Reduced the number of level-up notifications. From now on, you’ll see a single popup that combines the goal and the related stat increase.

Disabled opening windows via hotkeys when the window is currently blocked (e.g., map, calendar).

Fixed potential issues where loading a save outside of the tutorial could block access to windows like the map and calendar.

Resolved a bug where recruitment survey results were not correctly applied to the player’s character when starting a new game.

Corrected the display of trait values in descriptions.

Fixed activity tracking so the correct number of completed activities is saved (important for certain progression goals).

Updated some in-game text.

Added quick binds for windows.

Fixed rebind options not saving correctly in settings.

Improved exam visibility in the calendar.

Fixed exam window not working properly in certain languages.

That’s all for this hotfix! Again, thanks for all your feedback and reports - and keep them coming so we can keep improving Campus Life!

Remember to join our Discord if you want to share your thoughts, ideas or simply find some people to talk to about the game.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ba0f95be0a1ca463bdb62c87cfb2fc0f6849b803.png"]

Cheers!

~ Frozen Way & Game Formatic team

Updated localization

notes.title: From Millennials to Campus Life: Unveiling Our New Name – Dev Update #5
notes.notes:
Hey Students!

Ready for your first lesson this semester? Make sure you've got your notebooks ready, and let's dive in.

From our latest devlog, you're all caught up on how to ace this school year smoothly.

Today, we’ve got an update straight from the dean about some big changes at the university. Top of the list, we've revamped our campus name and given our logo a fresh update. Plus, we're excited to give you a teaser about an important event coming up in just two months that we’ll be participating in!

Without further ado, enjoy your college days once again!

TRAILER

It might not be a music lesson, but let’s kick things off on a high note today. Up until now, your sneak peeks at campus life were just a few gifs and screenshots. But guess what? We’re upping our game. Check out the first-ever gameplay trailer!

Embrace your inner student and explore what our game has to offer – from buzzing student life and customizing your own character to diving into extracurriculars. How you rock your years on campus is totally up to you.

[previewyoutube=GCMtCXRH-hY;full][/previewyoutube]

NEW NAME AND LOGO

Get ready for a rebrand that rocks:  "Millennials" is now "Campus Life." The title points straight at the core of our game, the student lifestyle, perfect for both current curriculum grinders and those feeling college nostalgia. It's all about the fantastic experiences of college life, real and imagined. Jump into a world where your choices mold your college story. Grab your gear and let's kick off the campus life adventure in "Campus Life!”
Along with our updated name, we've revamped our logo to better match the game’s theme and title. We aimed for a design that echoes other college crests. Now it ties everything together perfectly, enhancing the overall look and feel. Check out how the concept has evolved and let us know what you think!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/4ef505eda1b91fe5f433705bddf1fa506071ee1d.gif

STEAM NEXT FEST

We're excited to announce something we've been itching to share: "Campus Life" is hitting the Steam Next Fest this June. Gear up for this debut, where you'll get the chance to dive into our game's demo. Experience a slice of what "Campus Life" has to offer, and get a firsthand look at the exciting college journey we've crafted. We can't wait to show you what's in store and hear what you think!

KEEP UP TO DATE

That's all for today's devlog! We hope the new name clicks with you, that our revamped logo has grabbed your attention, and the upcoming demo has fired up your enthusiasm to dive into campus life.

As always, we invite you to follow our social media to stay up-to-date with the latest materials and information. 

For those who'd like to get more engaged with the community we also invite you to our official Discord server, where you can find exclusive materials and get closer to the devs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ba0f95be0a1ca463bdb62c87cfb2fc0f6849b803.png

Don't forget to add our game to your wishlist to ensure you don't miss out on any updates!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103090

Have nice lessons!

Fufu~

notes.title: Millennials update #2 – Character creator: customize your own college freshmen!
notes.notes:
Hello, Millennials👨‍💻

After our first development update, discussions raged like a storm. You've been very curious as to why we named our game Millennials, and we couldn't leave that question without a proper response. It happens to be a much wider topic than we thought, so we had to give you a more detailed answer. You'll find our explanation down below, so be sure to read till the end, not to miss it!

Before we proceed to the main course, I'd like to thank you guys for a warm welcome under our first devlog! Your feedback is always appreciated, so don't hesitate this time as well. For those who haven’t seen our trailer, you can watch it HERE. 

As we’re constantly developing our game, today it’s time to show you a new set of features as an introduction to the game. Without wasting time, let's head to the update.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/5d4cc88cd37ee68221c409f03e0250d49e3f54c7.png

Character Creator

Hey, you. Yes, you. Do you want to see something cool?

Take a look, it’s our latest invention – a Character Creator, where you can make and customize your own college freshmen! Don’t worry if you change your mind about their looks. You can modify him or her whenever you want while playing. 
Remember that the character creator is still in the development phase, but we wanted to show you the first look at a few options this tool will bring to the game.
Character customization allows you to freely manipulate skin color, face attributes, hair color, makeup, tattoos, and more. Let your imagination run wild, and dive into the creation process.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/7700a428be69b568880f9f0b95dc1243b5d90a38.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/80649acc634473af49704039c40bb34a7c0ccb9f.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/3eeb96d4a524cf995a4e96b3ff2405a14e4816ea.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/dd84e640aa14bc75b34e31e26a6ab95a72a83ce5.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/48b53d6a4ce6dfcc0488098108353b2165865e40.gif
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/5b6995ae0542e3ef4de381863b6b433fd242184c.gif

Animations

A set of good animations can truly breathe life into a video game. We still have a long way to go, but since the last devlog we’ve made some progress in teaching our NPCs to move. Look at the first glimpse of in-game movements and see how they walk, talk, dance, and even argue with each other.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/dbe6a3b74ade068dcf88c5514e25aa5bb8ee40d5.gif

Performance and recreation

Last time we took you for a little walk through the arts faculty. Today, it’s time for a little chat about performance and recreation. Let me clarify, it’s Human Performance and Recreation. It’s a space for everything to do with movement, games, and exercise.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/c29ace1a245b1fe4709b70dc9aafe5e0884124cc.jpg

In Millennials, we care about sports, that's why we decided to let you choose what discipline appeals to you the most. Pick between rugby, basketball and more. Think whether you want to take part in regular classes or call out for a casual game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/d9b7a6a7c45ef1780f84df5ecf239998b9957903.jpg

Faculty Administration

As a player, you’ll have to deal with some bureaucracy. In the life of every student, there comes a time when you have to visit the dean’s office. However, Administration faculty isn’t just that, it has an adjoining cafeteria which offers warm drinks and meals – as well as a nice spot for studying.,  

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/5c55750590ef3180790b11d64bf379a2a128c047.jpg

Classroom

What kind of student are you? Someone who passes the term by the skin of their teeth, or a conscientious teacher’s pet? Or maybe something in-between? I never missed a class but never got above a B+, sadly… It’s up to you to steer your freshman in the right direction, just keep in mind: without decent grades, you won’t succeed! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/1a2c31aedc406caebefa6dfa87f632f05a0afc04.jpg

Activities

Act like you know – for those who want to deepen skills related to theater, art, creativity, or improvisation we have something special. Consider joining “Theater and Arts club” and maybe you’ll be a future movie star.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/f35f1ccde7f519bb2022ed297969b80aebafc1cf.png

Why Millennials and not Gen Z

We’ve seen that many of you have been asking the same question: “Is this game really about Millennials?”. We understand the confusion, because judging solely by the trailer, the timeline doesn’t seem to be set in stone. Our game is set in the early 2000s, and the main point of it is to relive the memories of being a college student in that period. We know that the precise definition of when a generation begins and ends varies from source to source, but we can assure you that our team is doing their best to recreate this fascinating era. We want people of all ages to experience things that made this generation unique:
Y2K and the technological boom of mobile phones and gaming in general
The rise of internet and the humble beginnings of social media
The dominance of Pop and Hip-Hop in music industry
The bold and fancy fashion choices
The evolution of pop-culture and social communities.

So to sum up, the answer is “Yes” – the game is about Millennials. We hope that this clarifies things a bit and that the future updates will make more sense.


Keep up to date

That would be it for today, guys. We hope that you liked our little showcase, and you’re ready for more in the future. We’d also like to know if choosing the early 2000s as the setting makes you more or less interested in our game as a whole – it is set in stone, but we’re always interested in hearing your feedback. If something remains unclear, catch us in the comment section below, we’ll try to answer as fast as possible. 

If you want to keep up to date, remember to check our social media, join our discord sever and wishlist us on Steam – you won’t miss any future update this way.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43341897/ba0f95be0a1ca463bdb62c87cfb2fc0f6849b803.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2103090/Millennials/ 

Back to college we GO!

Frozen Way & Live Motion Games teams~
